[USER] User is interested in how music therapists use music to help people with mental health issues.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Music therapists use techniques such as active music making, improvisation, music listening, songwriting, and guided imagery to help individuals with mental health issues.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Active music making involves playing an instrument or singing to express oneself, boost confidence, and reduce anxiety.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Improvisation helps individuals express themselves, relax, and improve communication and social skills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Music listening can help reduce anxiety and improve mood.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Songwriting allows individuals to express themselves and process emotions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Guided imagery uses music to visualize calming images, reducing anxiety and depression.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] A study in the Journal of Advanced Nursing found music therapy reduced symptoms of depression and anxiety.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A study in the Journal of Music Therapy showed improvements in negative symptoms for individuals with schizophrenia.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A study in the Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders found improvements in social skills and behavior for children with autism through music therapy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A study in the British Journal of Psychiatry indicated group music therapy improved mood and functioning for individuals with depression.
